notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1 - Room rotate added.  This allows users to rotate the alley to fit their play area.  
To rotate the room:

    Press application menu button
    Look at television screen to left of the lane 
    Touch trackpad to bring up laser pointer
    Press trackpad when pointer is on the green "Yes" button under "Rotate Room?" to turn room 90 degrees
